title: Surface Normals via PCA (+ orientation)
hints: For each point: neighbours = knn(pts, p, k) (the point itself is included). Compute the centroid, then C = Σ (pᵢ − c)(pᵢ − c)ᵀ / k.
Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<Matrix3d> sorts eigenvalues ASCENDING, so the normal is eigenvectors().col(0) and curvature = λ0 / (λ0 + λ1 + λ2).
Orientation: if n·(viewpoint − p) < 0, flip n.

Degenerate cases: fewer than 3 neighbours, or λ1 ≤ 1e-10·λ2 (collinear) or λ2 == 0 (all identical) → valid = false. Subtract the centroid BEFORE accumulating, so you don't get catastrophic cancellation far from the origin.
